{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure sentinels)
data_clean = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
data_dedup = data_clean.loc[data_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final count of unique patients
num_patients = len(data_dedup)

num_patients"}
